title: AI agents and skills reference
summary: The AI skills the platform runs when it creates a campaign, what each produces, which model it uses, and the inputs it draws on.
bodyMd:
This page lists the AI skills configured under Platform Admin → AI Agents / Skills, the model each is assigned to, and the platform data they draw on. Use it when deciding which model integration to assign to a skill.

Skills

Skills run in sequence when a user launches a campaign with the AI assistant: capture the request, write the brief, generate storyboard and copy, then generate creative for every enabled touch-point. Each skill is assigned an integration from AI Models / Integrations, which holds the provider's API key. When the brief is written by hand, the 2 brief-stage skills are not used. The remaining skills run only when Generate Storyboard & Copy, Generate Campaign Preview or Generate Creative Assets is selected on the campaign.

SkillStageProducesModel in the demo tenant

Generate Storyboard & CopyStoryboard & CopyHeadline, sub headline, body copy, CTA copy and legal copyGPT 5.2
Campaign Preview RequirementsStoryboard & CopyRequirements for the campaign previewGPT 5.2
Campaign Prompt - JSON FormattingCreativeThe structured prompt passed to the image modelGPT 5.2
Generate Campaign CreativeCreativeCampaign images per playlist and orientationNano Banana 2 (Gemini)
Replicate Background Images (remove copy)CreativeBackground image variants with text removedNano Banana 2 (Gemini)
Generate HTML tags for a text overlay.CreativeHTML for the text overlaid on the creativeGPT 5.2
Generate a scene image prompt optimized for video generation.VideoScene prompt for a video campaignNano Banana 2 (Gemini)
Generate image criteria for a video scene frame.VideoFirst-frame and last-frame criteria for a sceneGPT 5.2
Generate Preview VideoVideoThe preview video for a video campaignLTX 2.5 (ltx-2-5-pro); Veo 3.1 (Google Gen AI, veo-3.1-generate-preview) can be assigned instead

Where the AI runs

Every skill calls its assigned model through your own integrations, with the API keys you registered, and every asset generated and signal captured stays inside your organisation's AWS account.
